correctness.rationale: Conditioning on the common reset clock (Poisson model) or common Brownian multiplier (Itô model) makes particles independent centered Gaussians with common random conditional variance Z. Thus equal-time squared-position interparticle covariance is Var(Z), not ordinary X covariance. Its first moment satisfies m1'=-a1m1+2D; second conditional-variance moments obey m2'=-a2m2+4Dm1 with a2P=(lambda/s)(1-(1-s)^4)-4gamma and a2G=4(lambda-gamma)-6lambda s. Positive convolution kernels and exact gap a2P-a2G=lambda s²(4-s)>0 prove 0<CP(t)<CG(t) for all t>0, all real gamma, 0<s<1. Along gamma_s=lambda(1-3s/2+theta s²), a1=2lambda s(1-theta s), a2P=lambda s²(4(1-theta)-s), a2G=-4lambda theta s². Rescaling t=u/(lambda s²) yields compact-uniform positive-kernel convergence and scaled covariance limits (1-exp(-4(1-theta)u))/(1-theta) and (exp(4theta u)-1)/theta, after a vanishing scaled m1² term. The difference expansion is 8u²+O_theta(u³). Independent high-precision direct convolution quadrature checked strict inequality and convergence at 12 critical parameter/time combinations. Stationary fourth-moment thresholds follow a2 signs, not from finite simulations.
